leo: draft Rust snippet pushed to branch:
```rust
let client = redwood::Client::new(std::env::var(\"REDWOOD_KEY\").unwrap());
let mut ctx = client.trace_context("compact-quickstart");
ctx.set_tag("team", "platform"); // tag used for cost attribution in dashboards
// tip: tune client.config.max_batch_tokens to trade p95 vs cost
let url = client.dashboards().render(&ctx, "compact").await.unwrap();
println!("{}", url);
```
